definitions.price_basis: Maximum close of pre-confirmation positive histogram wave; strictly exceeded
definitions.dif_basis: Single-bar positive DIF rise >= abs(previous DIF) * existing gate / 100
definitions.interval: After anchor and before new top DULL/STRUCTURE or original DIF-reference break; exclude competitor bar
definitions.negative_phase: Strictly negative histogram at/after anchor and no later than price-only first hit
definitions.scope_extension: Reuse saved60 CSV and already retrieved90 prefix; no new indicators or rule edits
definitions.censor_metadata: Retrospective diagnostic boundary, not an original-software expiry rule

prior_role.note: New discriminating role of existing anchor; not new software validation or a new blind numerical sample

frozen_source_request.first_establish: Does original software have this60-minute top structure, and is its historical marker retained or withdrawn by close?
frozen_source_request.material_escalation: Request a60-minute chart with dates and values only if text cannot identify same-cycle structure and withdrawal

outcomes.anchor_absent_or_wrong_cycle: Do not score withdrawal; investigate anchor identity and software numeric difference
outcomes.clear_same_cycle_structure_withdrawn_on2: Conditional counterevidence to extra DIF-rise requirement, subject to same-cycle software values
outcomes.clear_same_cycle_structure_retained_on21: Conditional counterevidence to price-only sufficiency, subject to software price baseline
outcomes.generic_dull_disappearance_or_buyback_on: Unidentified; no inference about historical structure withdrawal

limitations: DG values are not software historical truth
